raw_plan.root_cause: The function formats an attacker-controlled input string into a fixed 16-byte stack buffer at [rbp-0x20] via sprintf with format at 0x10004cf, without bounding the output length, so inputs whose formatted result exceeds 15 bytes overflow the buffer and corrupt adjacent stack data including the saved canary slot region.
raw_plan.original_behavior: Stores the input pointer, calls sprintf(dest=[rbp-0x20], fmt=0x10004cf, input) with no length limit, then calls puts(dest), then verifies the stack canary and returns.
raw_plan.required_invariant: At most 15 bytes plus a NUL terminator may be written into the 16-byte destination buffer at [rbp-0x20]; the stack canary at [rbp-8] and saved frame must remain intact.
raw_plan.repair_strategy: Bound the formatted output to the 16-byte destination capacity before or during the sprintf call: reject/truncate inputs whose formatted length would exceed 15 bytes, ensuring the write stays within [rbp-0x20, rbp-0x10) and appending a NUL. Preserve the normal sprintf-then-puts behavior for inputs that fit.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: For inputs that do not fit in 15 bytes, do not perform the overflowing write; return without corrupting the buffer or canary (reject path), leaving observable behavior for valid inputs unchanged.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: Valid inputs whose formatted result is at most 15 bytes are formatted into [rbp-0x20] and printed via puts exactly as before; oversized inputs are rejected so no bytes beyond the 16-byte buffer are written and the canary check passes.
verification_conditions: Destination write length <= 15 bytes plus NUL for all inputs
Stack canary at [rbp-8] unchanged after call
puts receives the same NUL-terminated string for valid inputs as original
Only direct calls to 0x108a6d0 and 0x108a31c are emitted
Function terminates with ret and preserves SysV callee-saved registers and stack alignment

note: baseline is deterministic; AI target assembly is accepted only by native/qemu PoC+regression. baseline_target_strict calls repair_any(target=<case target>, require_target=True) and records the resolved target_scope plus target_in_scope (every produced action inside the target; empty action lists are not in scope). baseline_target_aware receives the same target/capacity hint; ai_blind uses the public AI path without target. allow_calls only permits direct calls already present in the target function.
evaluation_note: deterministic baselines run on the host; PoC evaluation and the unstripped x86-64 target execution run in the Linux guest (Lima) via the poc/guest runner. Provider prompts/responses are never stored.
